characters.summary: Reed Richards of Earth-838 is a brilliant scientist and leader of the Illuminati who possesses immense elasticity and malleable physiology, allowing him to stretch his body into various shapes. In combat, he relies heavily on his intellect and analytical approach, though he can engage in flexible melee combat.

mechanisms: Malleable form that absorbs blunt trauma

weaknesses: Vulnerable to matter manipulation or disintegration
limitations: Overconfident in his intellect and scientific solutions against magic

sources.supports: General character background and alternate universe appearances in the MCU.
Abilities, combat actions, and fate against the Scarlet Witch in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

feats.claim: Stretched his body during deliberations with the Illuminati and attempted to counter Wanda Maximoff.
feats.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

notableResults.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
notableResults.note: Killed when his body was unraveled by reality-warping magic.

unknowns: Full combat limits of his elasticity compared to his Earth-616 counterpart are not shown in the MCU.

characters.summary: Michelle Jones-Watson (MJ) is a sharp-witted, resourceful high school student and ally to Spider-Man. She does not possess superhuman abilities and relies on quick thinking, improvisational defensive maneuvers, and throwing objects when caught in combat situations.
limitations: Lacks superpowers, advanced training, or specialized combat gear.

sources.supports: Character overview and role in the Spider-Man MCU trilogy.
Involvement in battles and encounters with villains.

feats.claim: Struck villains with a mace and various heavy objects to defend herself.

notableResults.note: Captured during the final battle at the Statue of Liberty.

characters.summary: Monica Rambeau is a physicist and former S.W.A.R.D. agent who gained energy-manipulation powers after passing through the Hex energy barrier. She can absorb, manipulate, and project various types of electromagnetic radiation and energy, allowing her to phase through physical attacks and fly.

techniques: Absorption of ballistic and energy fire

mechanisms: Energy phase-shifting to let projectiles pass through her body

weaknesses: Exhaustion from absorbing massive energy loads
limitations: Power limits when handling high-intensity entangled light fields

sources.supports: General character background in the MCU.
Powers, energy manipulation feats, and appearances in WandaVision and The Marvels.

feats.claim: Absorbed bullet impacts harmlessly by phase-shifting her body.

notableResults.note: Subdued during direct confrontation within Westview.

campaignTags.claim: Flies using inherent energy manipulation abilities.

unknowns: Full offensive destructive capacity following events in The Marvels.

characters.summary: Marc Spector is a mercenary empowered by the Egyptian moon god Khonshu as the Moon Knight. He utilizes peak human conditioning, expert martial arts training, tactical gear, crescent darts, and a mystical ceremonial suit that provides high durability against physical damage.
weaknesses: Mental instability and dissociative identity disorder
limitations: Vulnerable to psychological manipulation and conflicts between alters

sources.supports: Abilities, equipment, and combat history in the Disney+ series Moon Knight.

feats.claim: Fought off multiple armed jackal creatures in close quarters.

notableResults.note: Overcame attackers in a museum setting.

campaignTags.claim: Empowered by the deity Khonshu with mystical suit generation.

unknowns: Extent of healing capabilities without Khonshu's direct intervention.

characters.summary: Jake Lockley is the third, more ruthless alter of Marc Spector. Operating in secret, he utilizes the Moon Knight suit and abilities with extreme lethality and zero hesitation, catching opponents off guard.
weaknesses: Mental compartmentalization and shared body vulnerabilities
limitations: Acts under the direct orders of Khonshu unbeknownst to the other alters
characters.formDifferences: Represents the lethal third alter taking control of the body, characterized by speaking Spanish and showing no mercy in combat.

sources.supports: Appearance, combat actions, and relationship with Khonshu in Moon Knight.

notableResults.note: Executed a surprise ambush ending the conflict.

campaignTags.claim: Empowered by Khonshu through the Moon Knight identity.

unknowns: Full extent of his separate combat training compared to Marc Spector.

characters.summary: Steven Grant's persona manifestation of the suit, known as Mr. Knight, features a tailored three-piece white suit. While Steven initially lacks Marc's lethal combat efficiency, he relies on improvised weapon use, flexibility, and the magical durability of the avatar suit.
weaknesses: Lack of formal combat training compared to Marc Spector
limitations: Inexperienced in combat maneuvers during early appearances
characters.formDifferences: A distinct white business-suit aesthetic reflecting Steven Grant's personality, initially less violent and more analytical.

sources.supports: Abilities, appearance, and combat style in Moon Knight.

notableResults.note: Won after adapting to the physical demands of the suit.

conditional.dependsOn: Steven Grant being in control of the body

campaignTags.claim: Magical suit manifestation tied to Khonshu.

unknowns: Whether Mr. Knight possesses unique magical properties distinct from the standard Moon Knight suit.

characters.summary: Karl Mordo is a master of the mystic arts trained in Kamar-Taj. He is a disciplined and lethal combatant who utilizes mystical weapons, dimensional energy whips, shields, and spellcasting to subdue opponents.

techniques: Staff of the Living Tribunal creation

weaknesses: Rigid adherence to dogmatic rules leaving him vulnerable to ideological shocks
limitations: Relies on somatic gestures and magical focus for spellcasting

sources.supports: General character background in Marvel media.
Spellcasting techniques, magical artifacts, and combat history in Doctor Strange.

feats.claim: Created mystical staffs and energy blades to fight zealots.

notableResults.note: Successfully fought off multiple zealots using martial arts and magic.

campaignTags.claim: Practices Eldritch magic and conjures mystical weapons.
Casts complex mystic spells and creates dimensional artifacts.

unknowns: Exact activities and power scaling following the events of Doctor Strange.

characters.summary: Kamala Khan is a teenager who unlocks hard-light construct powers using a mysterious family bangle. She can project solid crystalline light structures, create stepping platforms in mid-air, and elongate her limbs or grow her fist for heavy impacts.
limitations: Power control is tied to emotional state and physical endurance

sources.supports: General character background in the MCU.

feats.claim: Created hard-light shields to block gunfire and projectiles.

notableResults.note: Defended her school using traps and hard-light constructs.

campaignTags.claim: Creates hard-light stepping platforms to traverse the air.
Powers stem from the ancient cosmic Bangle.

unknowns: Full potential of her genetic mutation unlocked by the bangle.

characters.summary: Quentin Beck is a former Stark Industries disgruntled employee who uses an elaborate network of combat drones, holographic projectors, and chemical illusions to simulate superhuman powers, monsters, and widespread destruction.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on external technology and drones; fragile without his tech support crew
mobility: Standard human movement supported by drone transport
limitations: Tech can be disrupted by EMPs or direct physical destruction of projectors

sources.supports: EDITH drone control, illusion technology, and feats in Spider-Man: Far From Home.

feats.claim: Trapped Spider-Man in a complex sequence of disorienting holographic illusions.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Spider-Man bypassed his illusions using Spider-Sense.

conditional.ability: Massive scale illusion and drone bombardment
conditional.dependsOn: Access to EDITH satellite system and drone fleet

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes advanced drone networks and holographic projectors.
Employs projection suits and tactical drones.

unknowns: Whether any backup drone systems survived his apparent death.
